import numpy as np
N=9
DIRS=[(-1,0),(1,0),(0,-1),(0,1)]
def nbrs(r,c):
    return [(r+dr,c+dc) for dr,dc in DIRS if 0<=r+dr<N and 0<=c+dc<N]
def P(r,c): return r*9+c
PTS=[(r,c) for r in range(N) for c in range(N)]
def I(r,c,pl): return (r*9+c)*3+pl
H=512
OWN,OPP,SW,SP=0,81,162,243
YW,YP=324,405
A5W,A5P=324,405
AW,AP,SA,EYE=162,243,324,405

def line(r,c): return min(r,8-r,c,8-c)

def build(prm):
    W={}; B={}
    W[1]=np.zeros((243,H),np.float32); B[1]=np.zeros(H,np.float32)
    for k in range(2,7):
        W[k]=np.zeros((H,H),np.float32); B[k]=np.zeros(H,np.float32)
    Wo=np.zeros((H,82),np.float32); bo=np.zeros(82,np.float32)
    # ---- L1
    for (r,c) in PTS:
        p=P(r,c); nb=nbrs(r,c); deg=len(nb)
        W[1][I(r,c,0),OWN+p]=1
        W[1][I(r,c,1),OPP+p]=1
        for blk,pl,bb in ((SW,0,deg-5),(SP,1,deg-5),(YW,0,deg-4),(YP,1,deg-4)):
            W[1][I(r,c,pl),blk+p]=4
            for (rr,cc) in nb:
                W[1][I(rr,cc,0),blk+p]=-1; W[1][I(rr,cc,1),blk+p]=-1
            B[1][blk+p]=bb
    # ---- L2 : S1 with rule (a)+(b)
    K=100.
    for (r,c) in PTS:
        p=P(r,c); nb=nbrs(r,c)
        W[2][OWN+p,OWN+p]=1; W[2][OPP+p,OPP+p]=1
        for sblk,yblk,cblk in ((SW,YW,OWN),(SP,YP,OPP)):
            W[2][sblk+p,sblk+p]+=1
            W[2][yblk+p,sblk+p]+=4
            for (rr,cc) in nb:
                q=P(rr,cc)
                W[2][sblk+q,sblk+p]+=4
                W[2][yblk+q,sblk+p]+=1
            W[2][cblk+p,sblk+p]+=K
            B[2][sblk+p]=-4.5-K
    # ---- L3..L5 : propagation
    K2=1e4
    for k in (3,4,5):
        for (r,c) in PTS:
            p=P(r,c); nb=nbrs(r,c)
            W[k][OWN+p,OWN+p]=1; W[k][OPP+p,OPP+p]=1
            for sblk,cblk in ((SW,OWN),(SP,OPP)):
                W[k][sblk+p,sblk+p]+=0.5
                for (rr,cc) in nb:
                    W[k][sblk+P(rr,cc),sblk+p]+=0.5
                W[k][cblk+p,sblk+p]+=K2
                B[k][sblk+p]=-K2
    # L5 extra atari flags from S3
    for (r,c) in PTS:
        p=P(r,c)
        W[5][OWN+p,A5W+p]=1; W[5][SW+p,A5W+p]=-100
        W[5][OPP+p,A5P+p]=1; W[5][SP+p,A5P+p]=-100
    # ---- L6
    for (r,c) in PTS:
        p=P(r,c); nb=nbrs(r,c); deg=len(nb)
        W[6][OWN+p,OWN+p]=1; W[6][OPP+p,OPP+p]=1
        W[6][OWN+p,AW+p]=1; W[6][SW+p,AW+p]=-100
        W[6][OPP+p,AP+p]=1; W[6][SP+p,AP+p]=-100
        for (rr,cc) in nb:
            q=P(rr,cc)
            W[6][OWN+q,SA+p]+=1; W[6][OPP+q,SA+p]+=1
            W[6][SW+q,SA+p]+=-100
            W[6][A5P+q,SA+p]+=-3
            W[6][OWN+q,EYE+p]+=1
            W[6][A5W+q,EYE+p]+=-100
        B[6][SA+p]=2-deg
        B[6][EYE+p]=-(deg-1)
    # ---- output
    for (r,c) in PTS:
        p=P(r,c); nb=nbrs(r,c)
        for (rr,cc) in nb:
            q=P(rr,cc)
            Wo[AP+q,p]+=prm['cap']; Wo[AW+q,p]+=prm['esc']
            Wo[OPP+q,p]+=prm['contact']; Wo[OWN+q,p]+=prm['ownadj']
        for dr,dc in ((1,1),(1,-1),(-1,1),(-1,-1)):
            rr,cc=r+dr,c+dc
            if 0<=rr<N and 0<=cc<N:
                Wo[OWN+P(rr,cc),p]+=prm['owndiag']
        Wo[SA+p,p]=-prm['sa']; Wo[EYE+p,p]=-prm['eye']
        bo[p]=prm['lineval'][line(r,c)]
    bo[P(4,4)]+=prm['tengen']
    bo[81]=prm['pass']
    return W,B,Wo,bo

def save_all(save,W,B,Wo,bo):
    for k in range(1,7):
        save('L%d.W'%k,W[k]); save('L%d.b'%k,B[k])
    save('out.W',Wo); save('out.b',bo)
'''

import numpy as np

NB=[[ (r+dr)*9+(c+dc) for dr,dc in DIRS if 0<=r+dr<N and 0<=c+dc<N] for r in range(N) for c in range(N)]
# board: np array of 81 ints: 0 empty, 1 black, -1 white
def from_strings(rows):
    b=np.zeros(81,int)
    for r,row in enumerate(rows):
        for c,ch in enumerate(row):
            b[r*9+c]= 1 if ch=='X' else (-1 if ch=='O' else 0)
    return b
def to_strings(b):
    return [''.join('X' if b[r*9+c]==1 else ('O' if b[r*9+c]==-1 else '.') for c in range(9)) for r in range(9)]
def chain(b,p):
    col=b[p]; seen={p}; st=[p]; libs=set()
    while st:
        x=st.pop()
        for y in NB[x]:
            if b[y]==col and y not in seen: seen.add(y); st.append(y)
            elif b[y]==0: libs.add(y)
    return seen,libs
def play(b,p,col):
    """returns new board, captured count; None if illegal (occupied/suicide)"""
    if b[p]!=0: return None,0
    b=b.copy(); b[p]=col; cap=0
    for y in NB[p]:
        if b[y]==-col:
            s,l=chain(b,y)
            if not l:
                for z in s: b[z]=0
                cap+=len(s)
    s,l=chain(b,p)
    if not l: return None,0
    return b,cap
def area_score(b):
    # black area - white area
    sc=b.sum(); seen=set()
    for p in range(81):
        if b[p]==0 and p not in seen:
            reg={p}; st=[p]; border=set()
            while st:
                x=st.pop()
                for y in NB[x]:
                    if b[y]==0 and y not in reg: reg.add(y); st.append(y)
                    elif b[y]!=0: border.add(b[y])
            seen|=reg
            if border=={1}: sc+=len(reg)
            elif border=={-1}: sc-=len(reg)
    return sc
'''

builder10 = r'''
import numpy as np
N=9
DIRS=[(-1,0),(1,0),(0,-1),(0,1)]
def nbrs(r,c):
    return [(r+dr,c+dc) for dr,dc in DIRS if 0<=r+dr<N and 0<=c+dc<N]
def P(r,c): return r*9+c
PTS=[(r,c) for r in range(N) for c in range(N)]
def I(r,c,pl): return (r*9+c)*3+pl
def line(r,c): return min(r,8-r,c,8-c)
def par(r,c): return (r+c)%2
H=512
C1,EW,OW,S3W,EP,OP=0,81,162,243,324,405          # L1
OWN,OPP,SW,S31,XE,XO=0,81,162,243,324,405        # L2
V,S3P=162,243                                     # L3..L5 (SW slot -> V merged, S31 slot -> opp S3P)
L6_AW,L6_AP,L6_SA,L6_EYE,L6_A2W,L6_A2P=0,81,162,243,324,405
MS=1e6   # magnitude multiplier for own S3 inside V
S3SC=10. # scale of S3_1

def build(prm):
    W={}; B={}
    W[1]=np.zeros((243,H),np.float32); B[1]=np.zeros(H,np.float32)
    for k in range(2,7):
        W[k]=np.zeros((H,H),np.float32); B[k]=np.zeros(H,np.float32)
    Wo=np.zeros((H,82),np.float32); bo=np.zeros(82,np.float32)
    # ---- L1
    for (r,c) in PTS:
        p=P(r,c); nb=nbrs(r,c); deg=len(nb); even=par(r,c)==0
        W[1][I(r,c,0),C1+p]=1; W[1][I(r,c,1),C1+p]=-1; B[1][C1+p]=1
        specs=[(EW,0,deg-4 if even else deg-5),(OW,0,deg-5 if even else deg-4),(S3W,0,deg-6),
               (EP,1,deg-4 if even else deg-5),(OP,1,deg-5 if even else deg-4)]
        for blk,pl,bb in specs:
            W[1][I(r,c,pl),blk+p]=4
            for (rr,cc) in nb:
                W[1][I(rr,cc,0),blk+p]=-1; W[1][I(rr,cc,1),blk+p]=-1
            B[1][blk+p]=bb
    def Yp(r,c): return EW if par(r,c)==0 else OW
    def S0b(r,c): return OW if par(r,c)==0 else EW
    # ---- L2
    K=100.
    for (r,c) in PTS:
        p=P(r,c); nb=nbrs(r,c)
        W[2][C1+p,OWN+p]=1; B[2][OWN+p]=-1
        W[2][C1+p,OPP+p]=-1; B[2][OPP+p]=1
        ys,ss=Yp(r,c),S0b(r,c)
        W[2][ss+p,SW+p]+=5-4; W[2][ys+p,SW+p]+=4
        for (rr,cc) in nb:
            q=P(rr,cc); yt,st=Yp(rr,cc),S0b(rr,cc)
            W[2][st+q,SW+p]+=5-1; W[2][yt+q,SW+p]+=1
        W[2][C1+p,SW+p]+=K; B[2][SW+p]=-4.5-2*K
        g=S3SC
        W[2][S3W+p,S31+p]+=g*(5-0.5); W[2][ss+p,S31+p]+=g*(0.5-4); W[2][ys+p,S31+p]+=g*4
        for (rr,cc) in nb:
            q=P(rr,cc); yt,st=Yp(rr,cc),S0b(rr,cc)
            W[2][S3W+q,S31+p]+=g*(5-1); W[2][st+q,S31+p]+=g*(-0.1+1); W[2][yt+q,S31+p]+=g*0.1
        W[2][C1+p,S31+p]+=g*K; B[2][S31+p]=g*(-4.5-2*K)
        for src,dst in ((EP,XE),(OP,XO)):
            W[2][src+p,dst+p]+=0.5
            for (rr,cc) in nb: W[2][src+P(rr,cc),dst+p]+=0.5
            W[2][C1+p,dst+p]+=-K
    # ---- L3: merge own S,S3 into V ; opp S3P init (rule a3) from L2 carry
    KV=1e11
    for (r,c) in PTS:
        p=P(r,c); nb=nbrs(r,c); deg=len(nb)
        W[3][OWN+p,OWN+p]=1; W[3][OPP+p,OPP+p]=1
        for (rr,cc) in [(r,c)]+nb:
            q=P(rr,cc)
            W[3][SW+q,V+p]+=0.5; W[3][S31+q,V+p]+=0.5*MS
        W[3][OWN+p,V+p]+=KV; B[3][V+p]=-KV
        for blk in (XE,XO):

            for (rr,cc) in nb: W[3][blk+P(rr,cc),blk+p]+=0.5
            W[3][OPP+p,blk+p]+=1e4; B[3][blk+p]=-1e4
        # S3P = relu(e - 2 - 4(1-opp)) ; e = deg - sum(own+opp nbrs)
        W[3][OPP+p,S3P+p]+=4
        for (rr,cc) in nb:
            q=P(rr,cc); W[3][OWN+q,S3P+p]+=-1; W[3][OPP+q,S3P+p]+=-1
        B[3][S3P+p]=deg-2-4
    # ---- L4,L5 propagation
    for k in (4,5):
        for (r,c) in PTS:
            p=P(r,c); nb=nbrs(r,c)
            W[k][OWN+p,OWN+p]=1; W[k][OPP+p,OPP+p]=1
            for blk,cblk,KK in ((V,OWN,KV),(XE,OPP,1e4),(XO,OPP,1e4),(S3P,OPP,1e4)):
                W[k][blk+p,blk+p]+=0.5
                for (rr,cc) in nb: W[k][blk+P(rr,cc),blk+p]+=0.5
                W[k][cblk+p,blk+p]+=KK; B[k][blk+p]=-KK
    # ---- L6
    cS3=prm['cS3']
    for (r,c) in PTS:
        p=P(r,c); nb=nbrs(r,c); deg=len(nb)
        tch = XO if par(r,c)==0 else XE
        W[6][OWN+p,L6_AW+p]=1; W[6][OPP+p,L6_AP+p]=1
        W[6][OWN+p,L6_A2W+p]=1; W[6][OPP+p,L6_A2P+p]=1
        for (rr,cc) in [(r,c)]+nb:
            q=P(rr,cc)
            W[6][V+q,L6_AW+p]+=-100; W[6][tch+q,L6_AP+p]+=-100
            W[6][V+q,L6_A2W+p]+=-cS3; W[6][S3P+q,L6_A2P+p]+=-100
        for (rr,cc) in nb:
            q=P(rr,cc)
            W[6][OWN+q,L6_SA+p]+=1; W[6][OPP+q,L6_SA+p]+=1
            W[6][V+q,L6_SA+p]+=-cS3*2
            W[6][OWN+q,L6_EYE+p]+=1
        B[6][L6_SA+p]=2-deg
        B[6][L6_EYE+p]=-(deg-1)
    u=486
    for (cr,cc_) in ((0,0),(0,8),(8,0),(8,8)):
        dr=1 if cr==0 else -1; dc=1 if cc_==0 else -1
        for d1,d2 in (((dr,0),(0,dc)),((0,dc),(dr,0))):
            Cp=(cr,cc_); Bp=(cr+d1[0],cc_+d1[1]); Dp=(cr+d2[0],cc_+d2[1]); Ap=(cr+2*d1[0],cc_+2*d1[1])
            X1=(Bp[0]+d2[0],Bp[1]+d2[1]); X2=(cr+3*d1[0],cc_+3*d1[1]); X3=(Ap[0]+d2[0],Ap[1]+d2[1])
            W[6][OWN+P(*Bp),u]+=1; W[6][OWN+P(*Dp),u]+=1
            for X in (X1,X2,X3): W[6][OPP+P(*X),u]+=1
            W[6][OWN+P(*Cp),u]+=-1; W[6][OPP+P(*Cp),u]+=-1
            B[6][u]=1-5
            Wo[u,P(*Ap)]+=-prm['cyc']
            u+=1
    for (r,c) in PTS:
        p=P(r,c); nb=nbrs(r,c)
        for (rr,cc) in nb:
            q=P(rr,cc)
            Wo[L6_AP+q,p]+=prm['cap']-prm['atk']; Wo[L6_A2P+q,p]+=prm['atk']
            Wo[L6_AW+q,p]+=prm['esc']-prm['def']; Wo[L6_A2W+q,p]+=prm['def']
        Wo[L6_SA+p,p]=-prm['sa']; Wo[L6_EYE+p,p]=-prm['eye']
        bo[p]=prm['lineval'][line(r,c)]
    bo[P(4,4)]+=prm['tengen']
    bo[81]=prm['pass']
    return W,B,Wo,bo
